starterPrompts.spriglet: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent sprite atlas for Nuvori, an original creature collector. Generate exactly 10 different grown evolutions of a green leaf fox, in a STRICT 2-column by 5-row evenly spaced grid. Each sprite isolated entirely inside its own equal cell, all full-body three-quarter front views, 20% transparent padding on every side of each cell, no cut off ears/tails, no shared effects across cells. Cute detailed 2D pixel-inspired RPG sprite artwork, crisp dark outlines, readable at 80px, emerald/ivory main palette, elaborate distinct silhouettes not recolors. Row1 (penultimate forms): left rose-armored antler fox, right willow spirit fox with flowing leafy cloak. Rows2-5 (final forms, bigger adult proportions, taller than row1): row2 left ghost-thorn royal fox with crescent mane, right giant obsidian-briar forest sentinel fox; row3 left rose-crowned regal fox with broad blooming nine tails, right thorn-plate fox knight with huge stag antlers; row4 left celestial ivy fox with starlit leaf fan, right aurora sakura fox with sweeping orchid wings; row5 left ancient willow fox with branch antlers and long moss beard, right towering white-green cedar fox with layered pine tail plumes. NO words, letters, numbers, labels, borders, scenery, bases, ground shadows or checkerboard. Actual transparent alpha backdrop. Uniform exact 2x5 cell layout is critical for automated cropping. Canvas tall aspect ratio 2:5.
